title: ICS segmentation & IT/OT bridge assessment (no write/control)
description: Identify conduits, exposed OT, and segmentation gaps; read-identify only.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. Active/read-identify allowed; **NO write/control/actuation**. 1) Map IT↔OT conduits: jump hosts, dual-homed systems, VPN/remote access into control zones, historians/DMZ, vendor access, data diodes (observe presence). 2) From IT vantage (in scope), test reachability to OT subnets/services (read-identify scans at safe rate) — record what’s exposed (e.g., 502/102/44818/20000/2404/4840/47808 reachable). 3) From OT vantage (if in scope), identify egress/paths to IT. 4) Check HMI/EWS exposure (web mgmt/auth, default creds risk — controlled, non-destructive). 5) Findings: segmentation gaps, IT-reachable ICS protocols, exposed HMIs/EWS — with asset criticality. No writes/commands to controllers.
